page.overview:
What is Hydrapple?

Hydrapple is a serpentine dragon-like Pokémon that lives in a candy apple, in which appears similar to its pre-evolution, Dipplin. There are seven 'Syrpents' that inhabit this apple, two of which only have their tails showing, which they use to move this Pokémon around. Four other heads are often hidden in the syrup of the apple, which they then only have the back of their eyes showing. The final head is in the center of the apple, and is distinguished by its much longer neck, and two horns on its head, the right one has an apple appearing similar to Applin’s.

The center head of Hydrapple is the commander of the Pokémon. The many heads have unstable personalities, but on the occasion, they can decide to attack as one, they can unleash their true power.

In addition to the syrup-based abilities of its pre-evolved form, Hydrapple's signature move, Fickle Beam, implies they can also shoot lasers out of their mouth.

Hydrapple evolves from Dipplin when leveled up while learning Dragon Cheer and is one of the final evolutions of Applin, the other being Flapple and Appletun.
